_comment: Hard-case set for the diarization benchmark. Audio is never
committed: prepare_hard_cases.py downloads the AMI meetings
(single distant microphone Array1-01, AMI corpus mirror,
CC BY 4.0) and the pyannote/AMI-diarization-setup only_words
references, crops each window and synthesises the noise case.
Generated by select_hard_cases.py from the reference RTTMs;
regenerate only when deliberately changing the case set.

sources.noise: synthesised pink noise (1/f spectrum shaped from seeded Gaussian noise), prepare_hard_cases.py

cases.name: overlap
cases.description: largest fraction of overlapping speech in a 120 s window

cases.name: short_turns
cases.description: most reference turns under 1 s (backchannels) in a 120 s window

cases.name: return_after_gap
cases.description: a speaker silent for longer than the rolling buffer returns; window spans 30 s before leaving to 30 s after returning

cases.name: four_speakers
cases.description: 120 s window in which the most reference speakers each have at least 10 s of speech

cases.name: noise_clean
cases.description: clean counterpart of the noise case (same audio, no added noise)

cases.name: noise_pink_snr5
cases.description: same window with pink noise mixed at 5 dB SNR (speech power measured over reference speech regions), seed 20261002
